title: Lantern: convert legacy admin runbooks into typed, idempotent tasks
creator: Priya Raman
description: Background: We have ~120 legacy admin runbooks (Confluence + ad-hoc scripts). Lantern is an initiative to systematically convert high-value runbooks into typed, idempotent tasks that can be executed from the admin console or CLI with ambient context, RBAC checks, and dry-run/simulate modes. This ticket covers the first tranche: account-recovery, quota-reset, model-reload workflows. Goals: 1) provide a canonical typed schema for inputs/outputs, 2) ensure idempotent semantics and safe-guard rails, 3) wire in telemetry (cost, time, user, outcome) and 4) add automatic canary + rollback hooks for risky steps.
acceptance_criteria: Three legacy runbooks converted into Lantern task spec and deployed to staging
Each task exposes a typed JSON schema and validation errors surfaced in the console
Dry-run mode reproduces no side effects and returns a deterministic plan
Tasks are idempotent across retries (documented and tested)
Telemetry emits: initiator, route (console/CLI), input-hash, execution-duration, and final outcome
RBAC enforcement prevents non-admins from running destructive steps
Runbook execution history is visible in Console with linkable execution-ids

decisions: Use typed JSON Schema for task inputs to enable front-end form generation and preflight validation
Replace boolean 'force' with a two-step override token for destructive actions
Implement dry-run mode as first-class that produces a reconciliation plan but does not call external mutating APIs
Telemetry will use input-hash to group runs and avoid logging raw inputs; secrets will never be logged
Canary strategy: 10% of runs in staging funnel through additional verification hook before enabling 100% rollout
risks_mitigations: Risk: Accidental destructive execution via CLI scripts. Mitigation: require interactive confirmation for CLI and explicit override token for API calls.
Risk: Non-idempotent legacy steps. Mitigation: add snapshot/restore wrapper and unit tests that simulate retries.
Risk: Leakage of sensitive inputs into telemetry. Mitigation: use input-hash + redact fields; security review required before prod rollout.
